problem: Returning to Chat from another TriOS tab restored an arbitrary earlier scroll position, forcing the user to manually find the newest messages.
solution: Tab activation now emits an explicit bottom-restoration token. The shared chat view consumes it after layout and scrolls to a permanent final-content anchor placed after messages, BrowserOS output, and loading indicators. Initial appearance uses the same anchor.
lesson: Scroll restoration should be driven by an explicit navigation event and target a stable terminal anchor. Targeting the last model item misses transient content and relying on view reconstruction is not deterministic in SwiftUI.
